methodology.minifier: Conservative comment/whitespace CSS and inter-tag XML removal; not production optimizer
methodology.compression: gzip level 9; Brotli quality 11; each resource compressed independently
methodology.repeats: Each repeat = five decorative motif spans + one checked input; one CSS response and three unique baseline SVG assets per cold page. Equal motif counts do not establish optical equivalence.
methodology.assumptions: Cold: HTML+CSS+3 unique cached-on-first-use external SVGs for baseline, HTML+CSS for candidate. Warm: CSS and assets cached, HTML transferred. Zero HTTP/header/TLS cost; compression assumed even for SVG. Shared production control/token CSS excluded equally. Candidate whole stylesheet includes adapters and forced-colors; baseline only extracted geometry. Demo page overhead excluded. No winner inferred.
methodology.flatBundle: Production build-css.mjs embeds local SVG masks when flattening; external-cache scenario here models modular source CSS, not flat main.css.
methodology.select: Embedded SVG already counted inside extracted CSS; no extra request.
